input.summary: Remove the three-year take-or-pay commitment; fees payable only for Services ordered or used.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the USD 2,000,000 per-year, three-year take-or-pay commitment: our position is that fees are payable only for Services actually ordered or used, and the commitment as drafted (with no reduction or termination right) also contradicts § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no minimum-volume commitment. If a commitment is commercially essential, we can discuss limiting it to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer has no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment. Customer pays only for Services actually ordered under an Order Form or actually used, as applicable.
